text: As is clearly revealed by the bar chart, the number of parks in a Chinese city surged remarkably from 406 in 2020 to 532 in 2021, and further climbed to 670 in 2022.
Meanwhile, the accompanying picture depicts residents exercising happily in a neighborhood fitness area, with a woman praising the newly built park right outside her home.
Together, they vividly reflect the continuous improvement of urban living environments.
Several driving forces account for this welcome trend.
In the first place, it is widely acknowledged that municipal governments have increased public investment in green spaces, making it remarkably convenient for citizens to relax and work out nearby.
Furthermore, as living standards rise, ordinary people find it increasingly vital to maintain physical health and embrace an eco-friendly lifestyle.
Not only do these pocket parks beautify urban neighborhoods, but they also foster harmonious community relations and boost public happiness.
From what has been discussed above, this green trend is sure to gain further momentum.
Only by prioritizing ecological construction and public well-being can we build more livable and vibrant cities.
